terms.comment: The perfect and the participle come from another stem: sustulī, sublātum, which are also the perfect and participle of sufferō. “He picked it up” is sustulit.

phrases.english: I lift and lower the duvet.

phrases.latin: pellem anguīnam ubi vīderis, tollitō et conditō, nē quaerās cum opus siet
phrases.english: when you see a snakeskin, pick it up and put it away, so that you needn’t look for it when it’s needed

phrases.latin: ego tamen duo sustulī et ecce in mappā alligāta habeō
phrases.english: still, I took two, and here they are, tied up in my napkin

sources: Lewis & Short: tollo
